title:
EC or condo?
*Same price now*
source: source: EdgeProp (Rivelle avg $1,893 psf) · launch & transaction data
caption:
A new EC and a new condo, almost the same price. Which do you pick? 🤔

Historically the EC to condo gap was over 60%, and EC buyers made more. Today it is around 5%.

EC or condo? Comment your pick 👇

lines.say: You are a buyer. A new EC and a new condo, almost the same price. Which do you pick?
lines.cap: a new EC and a new condo, *almost the same price*. which do you pick?

lines.say: Historically, the gap between an EC and a condo was over sixty percent.
lines.cap: historically, the EC to condo gap was *over 60%*

lines.say: Twin Waterfalls EC, seven fifty psf. La Fiesta condo, twelve fifty.
lines.cap: Twin Waterfalls EC *$750 psf*. La Fiesta condo *$1,250*

lines.say: Back then, the EC made more. Up to one point two four million, versus six hundred and seventy eight thousand.
lines.cap: back then, *the EC made more*. up to $1.24M vs $678K

lines.say: Today, Rivelle EC averaged about nineteen hundred psf. New condos today are around two thousand.
lines.cap: today, Rivelle EC averaged *about $1,900 psf*. new condos are *around $2,000*

lines.say: When the gap is that small, the condo has no restrictions, for a similar price.
lines.cap: when the gap is that small, the condo has *no restrictions* for a similar price

lines.say: E C, or condo? Tell us your pick.
